ourCoffee.heading: From Farm to Cup.
ourCoffee.quote: “Every bag tells the story of the farmer who grew it.”
ourCoffee.paragraph1: We believe exceptional coffee starts with respect for origin. We partner directly with dedicated smallholder estates across Chikmagalur, Coorg, and seasonal African origins who practice biodiverse shade-growing and hand-sorting.
ourCoffee.paragraph2: Each micro-lot is roasted in careful small batches to preserve its intrinsic terroir — highlighting natural fruit sweetness, vibrant florals, and velvety milk chocolate body without charred bitterness.

about.heading: Opened with One Machine and a Big Idea.
about.paragraph1: Founded in 2019, Garden Cafe was born from a simple belief: that a neighborhood café should feel like an extension of your living room, filled with sunlit greenery, the comforting hiss of the steam wand, and genuinely thoughtful hospitality.
about.paragraph2: What started as a quiet passion project in Sarabha Nagar quickly evolved into a beloved community sanctuary. Whether it is your sacred 10 AM flat white, an unhurried weekend brunch over garlic bread and lasagna, or an evening conversation under warm Edison glow, our team is here to make your day just that little bit brighter.
about.imageQuote: “A table is always waiting for you here.”

cookies.bannerDescription: We use essential browser cookies & local storage to remember your food order bag, table reservations, and cafe schedule. We respect your privacy and never sell personal data.
cookies.privacyBody: We never sell your data or use third-party behavioral advertising trackers. Local storage and cookies are used exclusively to give you an unhurried, delightful cafe ordering and booking experience.

categories.necessaryDesc: Essential for the basic functioning of our website: retains your food order items in your cart drawer, operational schedule data, and manager login credentials.
categories.preferencesDesc: Remembers your guest contact details (name, phone number, and special seating requests) so you don't need to retype them whenever reserving a table or re-ordering your favorite coffee.
categories.analyticsDesc: Collects anonymous telemetry regarding page load times and popular menu browsing categories to help our culinary team optimize service hours and stock availability.

policySections.s1Title: 1. What Are Cookies and Web Storage?
policySections.s1Body: Cookies and HTML5 Local Storage are small data files saved directly within your browser. They allow websites to remember actions and preferences (such as dishes added to your cart, active filter selections, and order history) over a period of time.
policySections.s2Item1Body: Retains selected beverages and brunch dishes so you do not lose your items if you accidentally refresh the page.
policySections.s2Item2Body: Temporarily holds your table reservation token and party size during WhatsApp confirmation.
policySections.s2Item3Body: Stores current operational status (e.g. kitchen open, paused, or closed) to provide accurate ordering notices.
policySections.s3Body: We do not embed third-party surveillance scripts, cross-site advertising pixels, or data brokers. All data is stored locally in your browser.
policySections.s4Title: 4. How to Clear or Disable Cookies
policySections.s4Body: You can clear your local storage at any time by accessing your browser's Developer Tools or Privacy Settings, or by clicking the “Clear All Data” button in our manager console.
